name: @swiftagent/db
//schema-workflow: Schema changes: (1) edit src/schema/*.ts; (2) `pnpm db:generate` (tsc + drizzle-kit generate) to emit the migration SQL + meta/NNNN_snapshot.json, then commit BOTH; (3) `pnpm build && pnpm db:status` to inspect applied/pending migrations; (4) `pnpm build && pnpm db:check` to detect structural drift (exit 0 clean, 1 drift, 2 tool error); (5) `pnpm migrate` applies pending migrations and runs the drift check as a preflight against the last-applied snapshot, aborting on drift. Bypass the preflight only via MIGRATE_SKIP_DRIFT_CHECK=1 (loudly logged).
